SARS2_ALPHA_SPIKE.name: SARS-CoV-2 Alpha Spike Glycoprotein
SARS2_ALPHA_SPIKE.definition: N501Y enhances ACE2 binding. P681H near furin site. 50% more transmissible than WT. Mutations: 8. MW: 141178 Da. pI: 7.0.

SARS2_BETA_SPIKE.name: SARS-CoV-2 Beta Spike Glycoprotein
SARS2_BETA_SPIKE.definition: K417N+E484K+N501Y. Significant immune escape. Reduced neutralization by WT sera. Mutations: 9. MW: 141178 Da. pI: 6.77.

SARS2_GAMMA_SPIKE.name: SARS-CoV-2 Gamma Spike Glycoprotein
SARS2_GAMMA_SPIKE.definition: K417T+E484K+N501Y. Originated in Brazil. Partial immune escape. Mutations: 10. MW: 141178 Da. pI: 6.8.

SARS2_DELTA_SPIKE.name: SARS-CoV-2 Delta Spike Glycoprotein
SARS2_DELTA_SPIKE.definition: L452R+T478K+P681R. Enhanced furin cleavage. Dominated globally mid-2021. Mutations: 9. MW: 141178 Da. pI: 6.97.

SARS2_OMICRON_BA1.name: SARS-CoV-2 Omicron_BA1 Spike Glycoprotein
SARS2_OMICRON_BA1.definition: 32 RBD mutations. Massive immune escape. R0~15. Lower severity but unprecedented spread. Mutations: 32. MW: 140998 Da. pI: 7.34.

SARS2_OMICRON_BA2.name: SARS-CoV-2 Omicron_BA2 Spike Glycoprotein
SARS2_OMICRON_BA2.definition: BA.2 more transmissible than BA.1. Different spike mutations. Partial immune escape from BA.1 immunity. Mutations: 28. MW: 141058 Da. pI: 7.3.

SARS2_OMICRON_BA45.name: SARS-CoV-2 Omicron_BA45 Spike Glycoprotein
SARS2_OMICRON_BA45.definition: BA.4/5 add L452R. Enhanced immune escape from BA.1/2 immunity. Dominated mid-2022. Mutations: 30. MW: 141028 Da. pI: 7.32.

SARS2_OMICRON_XBB.name: SARS-CoV-2 Omicron_XBB Spike Glycoprotein
SARS2_OMICRON_XBB.definition: XBB.1.5 recombinant. F486P mutation enhances ACE2 binding. Dominated early 2023. Mutations: 35. MW: 140978 Da. pI: 7.4.

SARS2_OMICRON_JN1.name: SARS-CoV-2 Omicron_JN1 Spike Glycoprotein
SARS2_OMICRON_JN1.definition: JN.1 descended from BA.2.86. L455S mutation. Dominated late 2023/early 2024. Mutations: 36. MW: 140958 Da. pI: 7.44.

AB_CR3022.name: Antibody CR3022 (SARS-CoV-1 cross-reactive)
AB_CR3022.definition: IgG1 monoclonal antibody from SARS-CoV-1 convalescent patient. Binds cryptic epitope on SARS-CoV-2 RBD (aa 369-386). Kd=6.3nM to SARS-CoV-2 RBD. Partial neutralizer — does not directly block ACE2 bind

AB_S309_SOTROVIMAB.name: Antibody S309 / Sotrovimab (broadly neutralizing)
AB_S309_SOTROVIMAB.definition: Broadly neutralizing IgG1 from SARS-CoV-1 memory B cells. Binds conserved RBD epitope (N-glycan at N343). Kd=0.6nM. Retains activity against most variants including Omicron BA.1. Approved therapeutic

AB_LY_COV555_BAMA.name: LY-CoV555 / Bamlanivimab (Eli Lilly)
AB_LY_COV555_BAMA.definition: IgG1 monoclonal antibody targeting SARS-CoV-2 RBD epitope class II. Directly blocks ACE2 binding. IC50=0.02nM against WT. Lost activity against Beta, Gamma, and Omicron variants. EUA revoked 2021.

AB_REGN10933_CASIRI.name: REGN10933 / Casirivimab (Regeneron)
AB_REGN10933_CASIRI.definition: IgG1 monoclonal antibody (part of REGEN-COV cocktail with imdevimab). Targets RBD class I epitope. IC50=0.04nM against WT. Reduced activity against Omicron. Used in combination to prevent resistance.

AB_VRC01_HIV.name: VRC01 (HIV broadly neutralizing antibody)
AB_VRC01_HIV.definition: Broadly neutralizing IgG1 antibody targeting HIV-1 gp120 CD4 binding site. Neutralizes 90% of HIV-1 strains. IC50=0.33 μg/mL. Used in clinical trials (HVTN 704/HPTN 085). Structural basis for vaccine

AB_2G12_HIV.name: 2G12 (HIV gp120 glycan-dependent antibody)
AB_2G12_HIV.definition: Unusual domain-exchanged IgG antibody targeting high-mannose glycan cluster on HIV-1 gp120. IC50~1-5 μg/mL. Resistant to most HIV-1 strains due to glycan shield. Important for understanding glycan-dep

AB_MAB114_EBOLA.name: mAb114 / Ansuvimab (Ebola therapeutic)
AB_MAB114_EBOLA.definition: Human IgG1 monoclonal antibody targeting Ebola virus glycoprotein receptor-binding domain. Approved by FDA (Ebanga). Neutralizes Ebola virus by blocking NPC1 receptor binding. IC50=0.5 μg/mL.

DRUG_OSELTAMIVIR.name: Oseltamivir (Tamiflu) — Influenza NA inhibitor
DRUG_OSELTAMIVIR.definition: Small molecule neuraminidase inhibitor. MW=312.4 Da. Binds active site of Influenza NA (N1, N2). IC50=1-10 nM. Reduces viral release from infected cells. First-line antiviral for influenza treatment a

DRUG_REMDESIVIR.definition: Nucleoside analog prodrug. MW=602.6 Da. Inhibits SARS-CoV-2 NSP12 RNA-dependent RNA polymerase. IC50=0.77 μM in Vero E6 cells. Approved by FDA for COVID-19 treatment. Mechanism: chain termination afte
